scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @checkout/contracts && npm run dev -w @checkout/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @checkout/contracts && npm run dev -w @checkout/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @checkout/contracts && npm run build -w @checkout/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @checkout/contracts && npm run build -w @checkout/web
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @checkout/api
scripts.test:web: npm run build -w @checkout/contracts && npm run test -w @checkout/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run docs:check
scripts.check:web: npm run build:web && npm run test -w @checkout/web
